name: project_load
description: Compile and activate one standalone SystemVerilog top from an explicit ordered file set. Replaces the active project; repeat after edits or configuration changes. Missing dependencies and recoverable RTL errors remain diagnostics. If compilation fails, the previous project stays active; a compilation_failed reply carries attempted-candidate diagnostics. Returns file/configuration and diagnostic counts. Inspect get_diagnostics before using semantic results; completeness is not verified.

top_module.description: Nonblank module (or program) declaration name to elaborate independently with its default parameters, not an instance path. Parent overrides are not inherited.

defines.description: Map macro names to replacement text. Null defines a macro as 1 (Slang's default); an empty string gives an empty replacement. Values must be strings or null.

source_files.description: Nonempty ordered array of existing absolute source-file paths. Order and duplicates are preserved. The agent selects dependencies; the server also reads selected files' includes but does not discover missing modules/packages.

include_directories.description: Existing absolute include-directory paths, searched in the supplied order. Omit for no extra include paths.

single_unit.description: Default true: files share macros and compilation-unit declarations in source order. False: separate compilation unit per file; configured defines/includes apply to every unit. Independent of fragment size.

name: project_info
description: Return the active source files, includes, defines, tops, compilation-unit mode, metadata, Slang version and load summary without recompiling. Requires an active project. After a failed load this still describes the previous successful load.

name: get_diagnostics
description: Return active-compilation Slang diagnostics and analysis context. Returns diagnostics, returned_count, total_count and truncated; severity filtering precedes truncation. UnknownModule/UnknownClassOrPackage scope hints mean possible missing dependencies, not harmless errors. After a failed load this reports the previous active project, not the candidate diagnostics carried by the failed-load reply.

limit.description: Maximum items per selected collection after filtering. Default 100; range 1–500. total_count is the number before truncation, not the returned item count.

severity.description: Optional case-insensitive exact severity: ignored, note, warning, error or fatal. Omit to include all severities.

name: find_symbol
description: Find indexed declarations by exact short name in the active compilation. Returns symbols with symbol_id, qualified_name, kind and location, plus match_count. No substring/wildcard search and no result limit. Multiple instances can yield multiple matches; use list_symbols with a known scope to bound results.

name.description: Nonempty exact short declaration name, such as bank_sel_ff; not a qualified path.

name: describe_symbol
description: Describe one indexed symbol by symbol_id, full qualified name or unambiguous short name. Returns symbol, available type/width/direction, members and signature details; lists are not paginated. Module/interface signature details may come from a representative active instance. Use inspect_module for declared-default signatures and inspect_instance for effective instance values.

identifier.description: Identifier from current query results, full qualified name, or unique short name. Ambiguous or unknown names fail; this is not an arbitrary SystemVerilog expression. Prefer symbol_id if a port and internal variable share a qualified name; ambiguous identifiers fail.

name: get_hierarchy
description: Return roots containing the active elaborated instance/array and generate hierarchy. Uninstantiated generate branches are omitted. Select root and max_depth to bound the reply: omitting max_depth returns the complete subtree with no item-count limit or truncation metadata.

root.description: Optional exact instance, instance-array or generate-scope path, or loaded top name. Omit for all active roots. Unknown roots fail.

max_depth.description: Maximum child levels from each selected root: 0 returns root identity only; explicit values are 0 through 50. Omit for unlimited depth.

name: get_references
description: Return bounded source-level declarations and indexed uses of a symbol as items, total_count and truncated. Omitted kind includes all recorded categories. read_write selects all reads/writes once; item kinds remain precise. Port bindings are ordinary-port actual accesses, not netlist connectivity. System-call accesses can be unknown; inactive procedural branches can still contribute. Empty results do not prove no uses: indexing is incomplete, and type_reference is not currently populated.

symbol.description: Current symbol_id, exact full elaborated qualified_name (cpu.bank_sel_ff when cpu is top), or unambiguous short name. Package members use pkg::member. Use instance paths, not module-type prefixes; arbitrary member/select expressions are unsupported.

kind.description: Optional exact filter. read/write each include combined accesses; read_write is their union, excluding declarations/unknowns. On a returned item read_write means a combined access such as +=, ++ or inout/ref. port_connection filters binding context. type_reference is not currently indexed.

limit.description: Maximum items per selected collection after filtering. Default 100; range 1–500. total_count is the number before truncation, not the returned item count.

name: list_symbols
description: Return direct indexed members as items, total_count and truncated; no recursive traversal. Module/interface names select default-elaborated members. Nested instance/generate paths select their effective scopes. Defaults produce default-context identifiers, not a substitute for an active instance when querying references. If a declaration cannot be elaborated as a standalone top, its default-member query fails; use an active instance scope where available.

scope.description: Current symbol_id, module/interface declaration name for default members, or exact nested instance/generate path. A top path equal to a module name selects defaults.

kind.description: Optional exact normalized kind, such as variable, net, port or parameter. Unknown kinds simply match nothing; filter applies before the limit.

limit.description: Maximum items per selected collection after filtering. Default 100; range 1–500. total_count is the number before truncation, not the returned item count.

name: list_instances
description: Return active elaborated module/interface instances as items, total_count and truncated, including the top. Optional filters are combined with AND before the limit. Generate containers are shown by get_hierarchy instead. No offset pagination; narrow the filters for large result sets.

sv_module.description: Optional exact declaration/type name, such as fifo, not an instance path.

name.description: Optional exact short instance name; multiple instances may share it.

path_prefix.description: Optional literal prefix of the full instance path. This is string-prefix matching, so top.u1 also matches top.u10.

limit.description: Maximum items per selected collection after filtering. Default 100; range 1–500. total_count is the number before truncation, not the returned item count.

name: list_instance_facts
description: Return bounded facts for matching active instances of one module/interface type: each item has instance, effective parameters and resolved port connections. limit bounds instances; fact_limit separately bounds each nested parameter/connection collection. Counts/truncation are reported at each level. Optional name/path_prefix filters use list_instances semantics; this is not every instance if truncated.

sv_module.description: Required exact module/interface declaration name, not an instance path.

parameter_names.description: Optional exact parameter names, filtered before fact_limit. Omit for all; [] selects none. Missing names are ignored; at most 500 names.

port_names.description: Optional exact formal port names, filtered before fact_limit. Omit for all; [] selects none. Missing names are ignored; at most 500 names.

limit.description: Maximum items per selected collection after filtering. Default 100; range 1–500. total_count is the number before truncation, not the returned item count.

fact_limit.description: Maximum items in each nested parameter/connection collection after name filtering, independently per instance. Default 100; range 1–500.

name.description: Optional exact short instance name, combined with sv_module and path_prefix.

path_prefix.description: Optional literal full-path prefix, combined with the other filters.

name: get_state_elements
description: Return bounded signal/block write records from always_ff procedures in all active instances of a module/interface type, with symbol, type, width, block ID and location. The same signal can appear for different blocks. Includes source accesses, not proven reachable hardware state; does not infer resets, latches, synthesis behavior or state in ordinary always/initial blocks.

sv_module.description: Module/interface declaration name or definition symbol_id. The query aggregates its active instances, not a single instance path.

limit.description: Maximum items per selected collection after filtering. Default 100; range 1–500. total_count is the number before truncation, not the returned item count.

name: inspect_module
description: Inspect a module/interface declaration using standalone default parameters. Returns definition identity plus selected sections; defaults are parameters and ports. Optional children/procedures aggregate active instances of this type; diagnostic_count covers the entire declaration source file. Unrequested sections are not evaluated. Collections default to 100 items (maximum 500); filter names for large signatures and check each collection's total_count/truncated. Default signature sections can fail when standalone elaboration is unavailable, for example for interfaces; identity-only inspection does not require default elaboration.

sv_module.description: Module/interface declaration name or definition symbol_id, not an instance path.

limit.description: Maximum items per selected collection after filtering. Default 100; range 1–500. total_count is the number before truncation, not the returned item count.

fields.description: Sections to return; omit for parameters and ports; [] returns definition only. declaration_count counts indexed default members; children are direct child instances across active parents; procedures contain source read/write summaries capped separately at 500; diagnostic_count is source-file-wide.

parameter_names.description: Exact parameter names, filtered before the parameter collection limit. Omit for all; [] selects none. Missing names are ignored; at most 500 names.

port_names.description: Exact port names, filtered before the port collection limit. Omit for all; [] selects none. Missing names are ignored; at most 500 names.

name: inspect_instance
description: Inspect one active elaborated instance using its effective parameters. Returns instance identity plus selected sections; defaults are parameters and source-level port connections. Optional children lists direct child instances, including those within generate scopes. Unrequested sections are not evaluated. Each collection defaults to 100 items (maximum 500); filter parameter/port names and check total_count/truncated.

instance_path.description: Full elaborated instance path, or an unambiguous short instance name. Prefer exact paths returned by list_instances; unknown/ambiguous names fail.

limit.description: Maximum items per selected collection after filtering. Default 100; range 1–500. total_count is the number before truncation, not the returned item count.

fields.description: Sections to return; omit for parameters and connections; [] returns instance identity only. children contains instances, not generate-container nodes.

parameter_names.description: Exact parameter names, filtered before the parameter collection limit. Omit for all; [] selects none. Missing names are ignored; at most 500 names.

port_names.description: Exact formal port names, filtered before the connection collection limit. Omit for all; [] selects none. Missing names are ignored; at most 500 names.

name: expand_macro
description: Return emitted SystemVerilog token text for one recorded user/configured macro invocation in the active compilation, including nested expansions, substituted arguments and pasted identifiers. Query the backtick or macro name by physical file/line/byte-column. Uses the loaded snapshot without recompiling or rereading source contents; reload after edits. Honors source order, includes, defines and compilation-unit mode. Inactive, undefined, intrinsic or ambiguously repeated include contexts may have no selectable expansion; errors do not change the active design. Inspect diagnostics when RTL is invalid. Returns name, invocation/definition locations, expanded_text, total_bytes and truncated. Preprocessing errors at the selected call are reported as errors, not empty expansions. Include-filename macros return the expanded filename token; macro-generated preprocessing directives are unsupported and return an error.

file.description: Absolute path to a loaded source or included file containing the invocation.

line.description: 1-based physical line in the loaded file, unaffected by `line directives.

column.description: 1-based UTF-8 byte column pointing at the invocation backtick or name, not its arguments. Tabs count as one byte; not a display or UTF-16 column.

max_bytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes of expanded_text. Returns a valid UTF-8 prefix, total_bytes and truncated. Bounds output size, not syntax-tree traversal.
